reference.title: Ransomware Protection Software
reference.shortdesc: Software used to prevent ransomware attacks on individual devices.

section.title: Ransomware Protection Software
section.p: While NC State uses multiple protection softwares and systems to protect university data, ransomware attacks can still occur on your own devices and pose a threat to the accounts you logged into on those devices. Consider using the following software to protect your data.

strow.stentry: Eliminates known ransomware, analyzes suspicious behaviors internally, and initiates file recovery.
Restores damaged files and contains antivirus features, but limits keylogger protection.
Recovers high-importance files and bypasses both encrypted and non-encrypted ransomware, but cannot recover all files
